title: Toggle passive mode
description: Soft dependency on the pasv_mode plugin. Replies `error` with code `pasv_unavailable` when the plugin is not loaded, or `pasv_requires_auto` when agent.mode is not 'auto'. Otherwise emits plugins.on('pasv_on'|'pasv_off'), which is asynchronous: the new state is only visible in the next `stats`.

message_id.description: Client-generated correlation id. When present the plugin echoes it in the reply and in the acknowledgment.
